integrity: A universal symbolic proof is supplied. Finite computational checks corroborate but do not independently establish all-orders, integral torsion-free, or priority claims.
scientific_limitations: Face and facet formulas are proved for finite spider trees only; integral homotopy and arm-permutation module are proved only for equal two-edge arms. No assertion for general trees or all k thresholds. Publication-priority comparison is best-knowledge rather than exhaustive independent clearance.
title: Four-edge-general-position complexes of spiders: exact facets and signed sphere wedges
